description: Run the console's single-page fix re-check and commit the result: a pass resolves the finding as fix-applied; anything else only records the verdict and leaves it open. Use this after changing a page, once audit_url shows the rule now passes. The result carries a research block with the latest SERP snapshot rank and AI Overview sample per query (up to 3; omitted queries default to the page's top Search Console queries — the block reads already-collected research data and never calls a vendor). It does not write an audit run or consume an audit run. Requires the audits:write scope. Writes need confirm:true plus a unique idempotencyKey; without confirm:true it returns a dry-run preview and changes nothing. Reusing the same idempotencyKey within 24h returns the first result.
name: verify_fix
title: Verify a fix and close the finding
